details.content: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi is a government initiative to support farmers with direct income support of ₹6,000 per year. This scheme aims to improve farmer income and provide financial assistance for agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
Eligibility for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi: All landholding farmers' families. Farmers with valid land records, Aadhaar card, and bank account. Small and marginal farmers are given priority.

To apply for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi: Visit https://pmkisan.gov.in or nearest agriculture office. Required documents: Land records, Aadhaar card, bank passbook. The amount is transferred directly to bank account in three equal installments.
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides comprehensive insurance coverage to farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Coverage up to ₹2 lakh with minimal premium.
Eligibility for Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana: All farmers growing notified crops. Both loanee and non-loanee farmers can apply. Age limit: 18-70 years.

To apply for Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana: Visit https://pmfby.gov.in or contact nearest bank/insurance company. Required documents: Aadhaar card, bank account, land documents, sowing certificate.
Kisan Credit Card Scheme provides credit facility to farmers for cultivation and other agricultural needs. Credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest rate with flexible repayment options.
Eligibility for Kisan Credit Card Scheme: All farmers with land records. Tenant farmers and sharecroppers are also eligible. Valid Aadhaar and PAN card required.
To apply for Kisan Credit Card Scheme: Visit nearest bank branch or apply online through bank website. Required documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, land records, income certificate.

Soil Health Card Scheme provides free soil testing and recommendations to farmers. The card carries crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers for individual farms to improve productivity.
Eligibility for Soil Health Card Scheme: All farmers with agricultural land. No age or land size restrictions. Priority given to small and marginal farmers.

To apply for Soil Health Card Scheme: Visit nearest agriculture office or soil testing laboratory. Required documents: Aadhaar card, land records. Soil samples will be collected and tested free of cost.
National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) is an online trading platform for agricultural commodities. It provides better price discovery and transparent auction process for farmers to sell their produce.
Eligibility for National Agriculture Market: All farmers and traders can register. Valid mobile number and bank account required. No registration fee.
To register on National Agriculture Market: Visit https://www.enam.gov.in or nearest e-NAM mandi. Required documents: Aadhaar card, bank account details, mobile number.
Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana promotes organic farming through cluster approach. Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming adoption.
Eligibility for Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming. Group formation of minimum 50 farmers required. Land should be suitable for organic farming.
To apply for Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana: Contact nearest agriculture office or visit https://pgsindia-ncof.gov.in. Required documents: Aadhaar card, land records, group formation certificate.
Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana aims to achieve 4% annual growth in agriculture sector. Provides financial assistance for agricultural infrastructure development and farmer welfare programs.
Eligibility for Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana: State governments and farmer organizations can apply for projects. Individual farmers benefit through state-level programs.
To benefit from Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana: Contact state agriculture department for ongoing projects. Farmers can participate in various sub-schemes and programs.
Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure scheme supports development of marketing infrastructure like warehouses, cold storage, and processing units. Provides subsidy for infrastructure development.
Eligibility for Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure: Farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, and private entrepreneurs. Project should be economically viable and benefit farmers.
To apply for Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure: Submit project proposal to state agriculture marketing board. Required documents: Project report, land documents, registration certificate.
Crop Insurance Scheme provides comprehensive insurance coverage against crop loss. Covers natural calamities, pests, diseases, and post-harvest losses with affordable premium.
Eligibility for Crop Insurance Scheme: All farmers growing insured crops. Both loanee and non-loanee farmers eligible. Coverage available for all major crops.
To apply for Crop Insurance Scheme: Visit nearest bank, insurance company, or common service center. Required documents: Aadhaar card, land records, bank account, sowing details.
Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) scheme promotes formation of farmer collectives for better market access and bargaining power. Financial support of ₹15 lakh per FPO over 3 years.
Eligibility for Farmer Producer Organization: Minimum 300 farmers in plains and 100 in hilly areas required to form FPO. Should be registered under Companies Act or Cooperative Societies Act.
To form Farmer Producer Organization: Contact NABARD or state agriculture department. Required documents: Member list, registration certificate, bank account, business plan.
